summary: POS Dashboard redesign (Bitepoint-style operations dashboard) testing completed. All 4 stats cards verified: New Orders (teal bg), Total Orders (white, clickable), Waiting List (white), Create New Order (amber button). Order List panel with search + filter tabs (All/On Process/Completed) working correctly. Payment panel shows search + 'No pending payments' status. Popular Dishes and Out of Stock panels render. Charts (Sales Trend, Order Types) display at bottom. Modal functionality tested: Total Orders detail modal and Receipt/Bill modal with print button. Mobile responsive layout at 375px verified - 2-column stats grid, stacked panels, hamburger menu working.

issues: Console warning: Recharts width/height warning on initial render - minor visual glitch during chart resize
